## How it was checked

- [ ] `cargo fmt --all --check`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo test --workspace` pass
- [ ] A test covers the new or fixed behavior (or why one isn't possible)
- [ ] User-visible changes have a line in `CHANGELOG.md` under "Unreleased"
- [ ] Docs updated if behavior, commands or settings changed (`README.md`, `docs/`, a setting's doc comment)
- [ ] Anything that needs a real agent, GitHub or the sandbox was tried by hand (say how)
